profile.headline: Software Engineer at Carpe Data
profile.summary: Software Engineer with a focused in big data. Skilled in Scala, Python, and SQL with professional experience working with Spark, Airflow, Docker, and AWS Cloud. Strong self learner and problem solver with a Bachelor of Science in Mathematics and Statistics from UC Santa Barbara.

positions.locationName: Santa Barbara, California, United States · On-site

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.locationName: Santa Barbara County, California, United States
positions.description:
Carpe Data provides next generation data solutions to insurance companies by leveraging social media, online content, and other forms of alternative data. Utilizing Carpe Data’s data solutions, insurers gain deeper insight into risks and significantly enhance many aspects of the insurance life cycle, including underwriting, claims, and book assessment.

As a data analyst I'm responsible for creating and maintaining our business characteristics product. Business characteristics use an automated process to identify and extract phrases in our datastore that indicate certain services or risks a business may have which include: Fireplace on Premises, Elevated Surface, Mobile Payments, Alcohol Promo etc. I create regular expressions to build business characteristics that are valuable to insurance carries and help drive automation.

In this role I lead a third party engagement with a data labeling company that helps maintain high quality and precision of our Business Characteristics product. I also assist doing QA to our big data pipeline and data bricks that are delivered to top insurance carriers on a month to month basis.

I have created tools in python to automate calculating necessary statistics of business characteristics to make the process more efficient for the team.

positions.title: Credit Administration Intern
positions.description:
•	Work in the credit administration department assisting underwriters analyze financial statements, assess risks, analyze credit loan applications for new client relationships, and help manage existing portfolios
•	Handle reviews for CRE loans by spreading financial statements, performing cashflow analysis of borrower, collateral analysis, stress testing, market analysis, and visiting sites of lending commitments over $1MM while adhering to strict timelines
•	Conduct 3 year cash flow analysis to identify trends and risks of each assigned borrowing entity
•	Participate in loan portfolio management including financial reporting and covenant testing.  Manage loan tickler system and ensured required documents are received and processed
•	Interact with line lending staff, credit administration, loan servicing, credit operations, appraisal, legal and related personal regrading credit-related issues
•	Keep informed of changes in economic and/or market conditions that may affect credit risk and develop recommendations for consideration

projects.title: Time Series
projects.description:
•	Collected a time series data set on pig slaughter in Victoria from an online data base, and used R to perform statistical time series analysis
•	Analyzed and modified data set to remove seasonality and trend components 
•	Constructed a SARIMA Model and performed model diagnostics 
•	Forecasted values within a 95% confidence interval utilizing the SARIMA model

projects.title: Regression Analysis
projects.description:
•	Collected data from an online data base and used R to perform regression analysis
•	Constructed a model for forecasting energy usage of a building using time and weather parameters
•	Analyzed multiple models with different weather parameters and compared their R2 to identify the most significant predictors
•	 Conducted significance testing on weather parameters
